_code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed rate and spin-current reference inputs; no production integration.
scope: Conditional leading electromagnetic rates and unpolarized-parent spin currents. Source normalization, material transport, native recoil-spin integration and detector acceptance remain separate qualifications.

chi_c1_lattice.parameter_uncertainty: Published CF,DF covariance retained; independent rectangle envelopes do not assign a statistical confidence level or invent cross-form-factor covariance.

chi_c2_effective_pole.baseline: Gamma(gamma*)/Gamma(gamma) = k/k_gamma * |F(q2)|^2; no additional E1 factor
chi_c2_effective_pole.uncertainty_prescription: A two-quoted-error pole interval [0.51,0.91] remains outside the full physical range. This is a fit-model envelope, not a pointwise experimental confidence bound.

chi_c0_e1_benchmark.approximation: Constant leading heavy-spin electric-dipole coupling, including longitudinal A'; no quantitative recoil/higher-multipole/timelike uncertainty bound.
chi_c0_e1_benchmark.caveat: An integrated Dalitz branching upper limit is not a pointwise bound on Gamma(A') without an additional shape restriction.

eta_c_nr_charm_pole.prescription: 2mc=mJpsi, F(q2)/F(0)=1/(1-q2/(2mc)^2); leading nonrelativistic charm annihilation, not an M1 transition.

eta_c_rho_jpsi_two_pole.prescription: Eq14 with complex squared poles mV^2-i mV GammaV, renormalized exactly to F(0)=1. Alternative model, not a universal QCD upper bound.

h_c_lattice.normalization_caveat: Connected-current lattice prediction. Its electron/photon ratio exceeds the BESIII result by 3.2 measured standard errors (primary SecIV.2); photon-normalized and absolute-lattice choices must remain distinct. Fit errors do not bound disconnected or all higher-order physical contributions.

psi_2S_m1_benchmark.prescription: Unique parity-odd vector-to-pseudoscalar magnetic current, calibrated by an explicit psi(2S) to eta_c photon branching fraction. Constant F(q2)/F(0)=1 is an additional leading model assumption; k^3 and transverse A-prime follow the current, not an empirical timelike-form-factor measurement.
psi_2S_m1_benchmark.uncertainty: No universal omitted-timelike-form-factor or hindered-M1/recoil correction bound is claimed. Preserve this assumption in model systematics.

sampling_contract.parent_spin: Explicitly unpolarized parents only; no inferred polarization from ND generation.
sampling_contract.chi_c2_spin: The measured effective pole determines the inclusive rate only. Angular sampling separately requires angular_model=leading-heavy-spin-e1; this is an unmeasured higher-multipole/recoil assumption, not an experimental spin measurement.
sampling_contract.recoil_spin: Samples return rho[row][column]=[real,imaginary] conditional on sampled A-prime muons, with recoil-rest Cartesian polarization four-vectors transported to the lab. A J/psi natural-decay adapter must consume this density; ordinary Pythia natural decays are not automatically spin-correlated.
sampling_contract.lifetimes: Only the relative A-prime proper flight is sampled. The native parent flight, decay position, natural recoil branching and source exposure remain the caller's responsibility.

source_calibration_caveat: Use exact initialized Pythia branching tables only as generator-conditional calibrations. Measured physical branching fractions and alternative onium production models require separately identified inputs. Natural MPI/string/feed-down onia in ND must not be added again as an unmatched hard source.
